svg.aria-label: nbrain at a glance: mail, texts and calendar through Executor, X bookmarks through xurl, coding sessions and saved pages flow into brain.events; ingest indexes them into Postgres and keeps a git context repo; one MCP server, memory-mcp, serves both to every agent, each with its own scopes
